name: Zuo Jiaping
current_role: Listed by Hurun as a founder of Linkerbot (灵心巧手), Beijing; role not confirmed in public sources
profile: Hurun's 2026 unicorn-founder list names Zuo Jiaping as a founder of Linkerbot, a Beijing maker of dexterous robotic hands (Linker Hand). Public reporting names Zhou Yong (Alex Zhou) as founder/CEO and Zhang Yanbai as co-founder; no public source found linking the name Zuo Jiaping to the company.
interesting_fact: Linkerbot's Linker Hand line is reported to hold roughly 80% of the global market for high-degree-of-freedom dexterous robot hands (company/media claim).
notes: Could not verify this person's identity or role (searched English and Chinese name variants). Possibly a Hurun transliteration/listing issue. Company-level outreach would go via Linkerbot; founder Zhou Yong and co-founder Zhang Yanbai are the public faces.

name: Vivek Veda
profile: Chartered accountant and former equity/banking analyst who co-founded Bengaluru digital lender KreditBee (with Madhusudan Ekambaram and Karthikeyan Krishnaswamy) and serves as its CFO. KreditBee offers instant personal loans to millions of Indian consumers and was valued around $2B per Hurun.
interesting_fact: KreditBee has said it has disbursed over Rs 30,000 crore in loans to some 5 crore (50 million) users through a fully online process.
deep_cut_fact: He is also a co-founder of FACE (Fintech Association for Consumer Empowerment), the industry body launched in October 2020 that later became the RBI-recognised self-regulatory organisation for India's fintech sector.
notes: Low public profile; speaks mostly to fintech/finance trade press (ET CFO, Elets, IBS Intelligence). Company contact page lists only customer support (help@kreditbee.in), not a press line.
